what: GRADE v2 = predicted CLV of a moneyline offer (dec x closing sharp no-vig P(side) - 1).

model_choice.rule: lowest LOSO game-weighted MSE; ridge kept unless a GBM beats the best ridge by > 0.5% relative MSE

feature_definitions.ev_ml_sharp: EV vs sharp no-vig ML (median LowVig/BetOnline; tie refund); fallback ev_cons; clipped
feature_definitions.ev_sp_sharp: EV vs sharp SPREAD-implied P(win) (LowVig/BetOnline spread+juice -> total-aware margin model); fallback consensus spread-implied; clipped
feature_definitions.ev_cons: EV vs all-book median no-vig ML; clipped
feature_definitions.ev_model: EV vs walk-forward model p_model at eligible snapshots (injury report out, QBs confirmed), else 0; clipped
feature_definitions.sharp_missing: 1 if no LowVig/BetOnline ML at the snapshot
feature_definitions.n_signals: count of v2 (ev_ml_sharp>=2% & ev_model>=0 & eligible), v3 (ev_v3>=2% & ev_model>=0 & eligible), v4 (Tue/Fri/Sun window & ev_sp_sharp>=2% & ev_ml_sharp>=0 & ML<=+400) conditions met
feature_definitions.move_p: consensus no-vig P(side) now minus at first sight (<= 9 days before kick); + = toward our side
feature_definitions.move_pts: consensus spread move since first sight, points toward our side
feature_definitions.is_last: 1 at the game's last snapshot (~75 min pre-kick)
feature_definitions.disp: std across all books of no-vig home P (moneyline dispersion) at the snapshot
feature_definitions.best_gap: this offer's implied prob minus the best allowed-book implied prob for the side (0 = best price)
feature_definitions.key_pos: grading.key_number_side(consensus spread of our side, to 0.5): +1 right / -1 wrong side of 3/7

candidate_filter: price -1000..+1000; |1/dec - consensus no-vig P(side)| <= 0.12; EV >= 0 vs at least one of sharp ML / v3 median / sharp spread-implied / consensus / model (eligible)
letters: A+ >= A+ cut; A >= A cut; B >= B cut; else C
one_bet_per_game: first snapshot where the game's best predicted-CLV offer reaches the strategy's grade; that offer (book, side, price) is the bet

strategies.desc: One bet per game at the first snapshot where the best offer is A+ (pred CLV >= A+ cut); 1 unit.
One bet per game at the first snapshot where the best offer is A or A+; 1 unit.
One bet per game at the first snapshot where the best offer is B or better; units = pred CLV / 2% clipped to 0.25..2.

pass_bar.monotone: mean realized CLV of first-appearance bets increases with grade: Spearman rho across the 4 letters >= 0.8 (at most one adjacent swap, and A+ must be highest)
pass_bar.top_grade: A+ realized CLV > 0 with one-sided p < 0.05 (t on bet-level CLV)
